2609.37532.title: DScale: Scaling Block-Diffusion Speculative Decoding with Adaptive Verification
2609.37532.paper_summary: Growing large language model applications demand efficient inference. At high concurrency, block-diffusion speculative decoding suffers from verification padding, rejected candidates, and incompatibility between variable prefixes and fixed-shape graphs. Uniform truncation sacrifices acceptable tokens. We present DScale, preserving drafter architecture, weights, and full draft length. A separate 112K-parameter predictor requires neither confidence calibration nor hardware speed-curve preparation. Path-aware tiles reduce padding. Dynamic verify-length (DVL) allocation packs scored prefixes into half the native verification capacity. Fixed-address workspaces propagate changing boundaries through verification and acceptance while reusing captured graphs. On A100-40GB with tensor parallelism 1, Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-4B cover four datasets and concurrency 8-32, reusing each target's frozen predictor. Geometric-mean throughput gains across these configurations are respectively 43.9% and 48.8% over DFlash, 22.2% and 37.7% over DSpark, and 24.4% and 32.0% over Domino, with lower request latency. Cumulative ablations show that adding the three mechanisms successively increases geometric-mean throughput, while budget adjustment improves accepted-token retention. GPU profiling shows that complete decode-step time on GSM8K decreases by 30.8-52.5% relative to DFlash
2609.37532.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型應用的增長需要高效的推理。在高併發下，區塊擴散的推測解碼受到驗證填充、被拒絕的候選者以及可變前綴與固定形狀圖之間的不兼容性影響。均勻截斷犧牲了可接受的標記。我們提出了 DScale，保留了起草者架構、權重和完整的草稿長度。一個獨立的 112K 參數預測器不需要信心校準或硬體速度曲線準備。路徑感知的平鋪減少了填充。動態驗證長度（DVL）分配將得分的前綴打包到原生驗證容量的一半。固定地址工作區在驗證和接受過程中傳播變化的邊界，同時重用捕獲的圖形。在 A100-40GB 以及張量並行性 1 的情況下，Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-4B 覆蓋了四個數據集和併發 8-32，重用每個目標的凍結預測器。在這些配置中，幾何平均吞吐量的增益分別為 43.9% 和 48.8% 超過 DFlash，22.2% 和 37.7% 超過 DSpark，以及 24.4% 和 32.0% 超過 Domino，並且請求延遲較低。累積消融顯示，依次添加這三個機制會增加幾何平均吞吐量，而預算調整則改善了接受標記的保留。GPU 配置顯示，GSM8K 上的完整解碼步驟時間相對於 DFlash 減少了 30.8-52.5%。
